name: devflow
description: The devflow plugin: the RYOS working method, for any project.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: Locate, design, implement, review and commit through fresh agents; a behaviour map; claimable plan steps; a project manager; releases through a tested candidate; guard hooks.

plugins.name: devflow-ui
plugins.description: One evidence-based UI/UX review of a web page, a desktop or mobile app screen, or a game UI: a prioritized report with file:line fixes. The web path needs Node 22+ and a Chrome-family browser.

plugins.name: devflow-release
plugins.description: Releases through a tested candidate: build, release gate, a pre-release vX.Y.Z-rcN tested by the tester agent and the maintainer, then promotion of the same commit after a release review. Needs the devflow plugin.
